description.value: June is a brasserie-inspired restaurant and cocktail bar in Vancouver's Cambie Village occupying a two-level space, with a main dining room serving French-influenced West Coast cuisine and an intimate downstairs vinyl listening bar called Lala. The venture comes from the team behind Vancouver's award-winning Keefer Bar and has earned widespread press recognition, including being an Air Canada Best New Restaurant 2025 finalist. An expansive centre bar with an open-kitchen view and a deeply curated global spirits list — spanning dozens of gins, tequilas, and whiskies — make it a notable destination in the neighbourhood.
